name: Cu Sith Will
beast: Cu Sith, the Spectral Green Hound of the Moors

acquire.equipPiece: One braided tail-cord with a pale-green flame tip at the belt (the tail-flick); pale-green mist streaks and no footstep dust.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form hound-beastman: long snout and glowing eyes, tall ears, shaggy dark-green mane fading to mist, thistle-plate shoulders and bracers, lean digitigrade greaved legs, padded paws with flame claw-daggers and a curled flame-tipped tail.

equip.weapon: A pair of green-flame claw-daggers on the padded paws (the Third Bark itself is a sound, not a weapon).
equip.armor: Mist-woven moor armour: peat-dark bracers, thistle-spiked shoulder plates, wisp-edged greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: Shaggy dark-green mane that fades to mist; glowing white-green hound eyes.
equip.aura: Green moor-mist aura at the feet with will-o'-wisp sparks.

beastNote: Cu Sith, the Spectral Green Hound of the Moors
lore: A green-furred ghost hound of the moors whose paws leave no sound; its will carries a death-omen across mist and heather in a three-fold bark.
pitch: The Cu Sith is the Scottish green hound of the moors whose paws make no sound and whose three barks foretell death. Acquire keeps you human, gliding in pale-green mist streaks with one equipped piece, a single green-flame tail-cord at the belt, to run silently and fade into mist. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a shaggy green hound-beastman in mist-woven moor armour whose Third Bark is a death omen; it is the fast A-rank hunter with the loudest weakness in the roster, a strain cost per bark.
untrained: An untrained holder cannot keep silent: the borrowed mist leaves the holder's own steps ringing, the bark cracks the throat and strain builds with every moor-fade. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A lean hound-beastman in mist-woven moor armour: long snout with white-green eyes, tall pricked ears, shaggy dark-green fur fading to mist at the edges, digitigrade legs, silent padded paws with claw-daggers, curled tail with a pale green flame tip.
spirit.look: A translucent green orb like moor-mist with a faint curled hound silhouette drifting inside and tiny will-o'-wisp sparks.
